scenarios.name: opponents-mountain-produces-red
scenarios.why: 'Add one mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce': p1 controls only a Mountain, so activating the Stone adds exactly {R}.

scenarios.name: own-lands-never-count
scenarios.why: Fellwar Stone reflects only 'any color that a land an opponent controls could produce' (CR 106.5): p0's own Forest must NOT give G. With no opponent land the reflection set is empty, so the pool must stay empty and the engine's offer policy (considerReflected requires ManaReflectedCandidates > 0) omits the ability -- the not-offered assertion is exactly what fails if own lands were counted.
